about_the_game:
The official soundtrack for the Volkolak: The Will of Gods

The atmosphere has been given special attention: the sound palette intertwines with mystical motifs, immersing you in a dark mythical world where the fate of the world depends on the main character!


All compositions for boss battles are epic and keep you in suspense until the very end. Each track emphasizes the grandeur, confrontation, and price of victory, turning every battle into an inevitable test of the gods. Mystical music immerses you in a world of mysterious creatures, where every chord sounds like a spell and rhythm brings you closer to unraveling ancient mysteries.

We are working on the soundtrack for volkolak: The Will of the Gods, and currently there are 7 tracks available with a total duration of about 21 minutes.As we add chapters to the game and therefore new tracks, we'll add them here for free! WAV format is available.

Composer: Dmitry Sabirzanov
